title: Fix -fPIC with Cuda
body: Adds -Xcompiler to the Cuda builds, as -fPIC isn't an nvcc option
author: ultimaxx

comments.body:
I have no idea where this error comes from since there are no such variable in my code "errhip". I removed it a while ago seeing this. But while fpic is required on linux, it does not exist on windows. So I created another commit on top which solves the issue.
I hope everything goes well now, thank you.
